summary: Started Day 1 of the Next.js learning plan in namnx-vn/crm-demo. Created branch lesson/day-01-nextjs-foundation and PR #2. Added /dashboard, replaced the default home page with an App Router route playground, and expanded learning-plan/day-01-nextjs-foundation.md with exercises covering page.tsx, layout.tsx, nested routes, dynamic params, Link navigation, and Server Components by default. Existing /customers and /customers/[id] examples were reused. PR remains open for owner review/merge.
